standard-dialogue-before-the-completion-.player: What are you waiting here for?

standard-dialogue-before-the-completion-.npc: That is no concern of yours, adventurer.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.npc: Al Kharid will forever owe you for your help in saving Prince Ali. It's good to know that we have you as a friend.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.player: It's no problem. So how come you're still out here?

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.npc: We still don't know why Keli and her bandits took the Prince. I'm hoping I can find out. The place where they imprisoned him seems a good starting point.

standard-dialogue-after-the-completion-o.player: Well if you need help, you know where I am. Good luck.
